name: Ambiguity Embiggener
subtitle: embiggen is a perfectly cromulent word
rules: At the start of each player's turn, that player picks a number for X. Both players put X cards from their hand on the bottom of their deck in any order. (If a player has less than X cards they put their entire hand on the bottom.) Both players put the top Y cards of their deck into their hand, where Y is the number of cards that player put on the bottom of their deck.
notes: Catalog uses updated templating (chooses / Each player) and moves the 'less than X cards' reminder into the main sentence. No artist credit in footer.

name: Ameliorate
subtitle: i love the smell of booby in the morning!
rules: Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the top X cards of your deck into your hand, where X is the number of cards you put on the bottom plus 1.

name: Arcanology Recruitment Officer
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: At the start of your turn, you must pick a character your opponent controls. That character gains COVERT until the start of your next turn.
notes: Artist Series card; the artist (Silvia Gunarso) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer. Catalog says 'an opponent controls' instead of 'your opponent controls'; 'you must pick' is mandatory in both.

name: Cloaked Creeper
subtitle: "try to get to the buffet table"
rules: COVERT -- While this card is a member of an attacking party, the party is COVERT.
flavor: "Ah, Lord Frothingslosh...don't you look...dashing..."
notes: Subtitle is printed in quotation marks.

name: Deceptive Muddler
subtitle: invite him in for a drink and look what happens
rules: COVERT -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent must put a card from their hand on the top of their deck.
flavor: An Arcanist keeps his things "just so" with good reason. Nothing annoys him more than repositioning.
notes: Catalog: 'When ... that faction's controller puts a card ... if they can' vs printed 'If ... your opponent must put a card'. Same play in a 2-player game.

name: Dimensional Rift
subtitle: portal to anywhere
rules: TELEPORT -- COST – Pay 4. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
flavor: "I just teleported in from Lugubria, and boy are my arms tired!"

name: Eccentric Inquisition
subtitle: [imagine inevitable Spanish Inquisition joke here]
rules: Reveal the top 7 cards of your opponent's deck. Remove all revealed tactics from the game and put the remaining cards on the bottom of your opponent's deck in any order. -- For the rest of the game, you may play tactics removed from the game by this card as though they were in your hand and without having the proper resource icons.
notes: Catalog uses current terminology: void instead of 'remove from the game', deploy instead of play, threshold instead of 'proper resource icons'.

name: Ectological Hazard Suit
subtitle: the old model may be uglier, but at least it works
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When this card enters play, put a token on the attached character. -- The attached character gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: No STR/SPD/LIFE modifier badges printed.

name: Eldridge Gosche
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya
rules: UNIQUE ELDRIDGE -- At the start of your turn, you may pick 2 or fewer non-resource cards you control. If you do, put up to 2 tokens divided however you want on those cards. -- EJECT -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. -- DISRUPT -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and pick a card. Your opponent must discard that card.
notes: Artist Series card; the artist (Chris de Joya) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer. Catalog DISRUPT says 'choose a card in it. That player discards that card' (updated templating).

name: Emphatic Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: sinister fondler of voidal boogers
rules: COST – You may pick a character you control. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character as part of its cost then put 2 tokens on that character. (If you didn't pay this card's cost then you cannot put tokens.)
flavor: Never be the first to put your hand in a viscous fluid.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating and omits the printed italic reminder '(If you didn't pay this card's cost then you cannot put tokens.)', which is already implied by the main sentence.

name: Entangle
subtitle: limited edition artwork by FangWei
rules: COST – Pick 2 or fewer characters. -- EFFECT – This turn, the characters lose 1 speed. Draw a card.
notes: Artist Series card; the artist (FangWei) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer. Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Gnat
subtitle: they don't. but they should.
rules: If this card leaves play, your opponent must discard a card.
flavor: "I told her it was the annotated edition. And she believed me! Now I have to do them all."
notes: Catalog: 'When this card leaves play, an opponent discards a card' (updated templating).

name: Infatuated Armchair
subtitle: mecka-lecka-hi, mecka-heiny-ho!
rules: If this card leaves play, you may look at the top 2 cards of either deck. If you do, put 1 card on the bottom of that deck and 1 card on the top. Draw a card.
flavor: The armchair's thirst for heiny was boundless and unfathomable. We eventually had to put it down.
notes: Printed 'either deck'; catalog says 'any one deck' (same in a 2-player game, updated templating). Art contains nudity.

name: Insect Appreciator
subtitle: i always pick one out before bed
rules: When an attacking or blocking party is formed that includes this card, it must have an even number of members.
flavor: He gets mad when people confuse him with the incest appreciator.
notes: Catalog says 'formed including this card' instead of 'formed that includes this card'; same meaning.

name: Kinky Asp
subtitle: like a garden hose, only more bitey
rules: COVERT
flavor: Only slightly less deadly than the dreaded bent mamba.

name: Maladjustment
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya
rules: COST – Pick a resource you control. (You can pick face-down resources.) -- EFFECT – Put the resource into your hand. You may play a resource.
notes: Card prints 'Put the resource into your hand'; catalog says 'into its owner's hand' (differs if you control a resource you don't own). Catalog also uses EXTRA COST: templating. Artist Series card; the artist (Chris de Joya) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer.

name: Obsessive Compulsion
subtitle: a place for everything and everything in its place
rules: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put any number of those cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order. Draw a card.

name: Odious Diva
subtitle: ô rage! ô désespoir! ô vieillesse ennemie!
rules: Your opponent's hand is revealed at all times. -- DISAPPROVE -- COST – Pay 2. Name a card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand. Your opponent must put a card with the chosen name on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw a card.
flavor: "Honestly, Gertrude...just because we're out of mustard... There's no reason to make a scene!"
notes: Catalog uses 'Each opponent' / 'that player puts ... if they can' templating; same play.

name: Puddle of Goo
subtitle: out of the drainpipe and into our tummies!
rules: COVERT
flavor: According to Meldring's "Edible Slimes of Lugubria," the role of the human digestive system in the reproductive cycle of the hallucinogenic sewerslime is as vital as it is ambiguous.

name: Quotidian Disappearance
subtitle: don't know where they go, but i hope they stay there
rules: Your opponent must pick a non-resource card they control. If they do, put that card into its owner's hand.
flavor: Political enemies of Amalforact often attract the unwanted attentions of the firm's public compliance officers, who do their job with perverted glee.
notes: Catalog: 'An opponent picks a non-resource card they control if they can. If they do, put it into its owner's hand.' (updated templating).

name: Quotidian Virtuoso
subtitle: and...checkmate
rules: DISRUPT -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and pick a card. Your opponent must discard that card.
flavor: Queen to L5 and the tower falls. Your move.
notes: Catalog: 'choose a card in it. That player discards that card' (updated templating).

name: Recollection Bazaar
subtitle: "that time I ate too much pie" is always popular
rules: RECALL -- COST – Pick a resource you control. (You can pick face-down resources.) -- EFFECT – Put the resource into your hand.
notes: Card prints 'Put the resource into your hand'; catalog says 'into it's owner's hand' (also a catalog typo: 'it's'). Differs if you control a resource you don't own.

name: Ritual of the Knob & Pull
subtitle: no, no, you're off tempo, Mortimer!
rules: COST – Pick a character. X is that character's strength. -- EFFECT – If your opponent controls at least X face-down resources, destroy the character.
flavor: "Twist to the left dammit! Don't you remember what happened to Jenkins!?"
notes: Card checks 'your opponent controls at least X face-down resources'; catalog checks 'that character's controller controls at least X face-down resources'. Differs when you pick your own character (or any character not controlled by your opponent).

name: Ritual of the Ominous Urn
subtitle: pretty damn epic
rules: Your opponent must discard a card. You may search your deck for a card of the same type as the discarded card, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor: The nameless one twisted his inhuman appendage unspeakably, as an ineffable sound filled the unfathomable, indescribable sky...
notes: Catalog: 'An opponent discards a card ... reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.' (same play).

name: Rummaging Millipede
subtitle: it's right in front of you, fool!
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, you may pick a tactic in your discard pile. If you do, put that tactic into your hand.
flavor: I should have sent the centipede.
notes: Catalog says 'put it into your hand' instead of 'put that tactic into your hand'; same meaning.

name: The Deranger™
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Sonny Liew
rules: LOBOTOMIZE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and pick 2 or fewer non-resource cards. Your opponent must discard those cards. Your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Name prints with a trademark sign (The Deranger™). Artist Series card; the artist (Sonny Liew) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer. Catalog uses 'choose ... That player' templating. No STR/SPD/LIFE badges.

name: Toxic Cultivator
subtitle: this'll show those bastards at the fair!
rules: While you control an even number of characters, reduce the numeric cost of your tactics by 1, to a minimum of 1.
flavor: People laugh at my toxic pusgourd. But did they slave for countless hours, rubbing it with fat and feeding it weasel paste?
notes: Catalog: 'reduce the numeric cost of tactics you deploy by 1' (updated templating).

name: Unnatural Alteration
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn and not during a battle. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. If you do, X is that character's numeric cost. Search your deck for a character with numeric cost X+3 or less and reveal it. You may play that card for free. (You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.) If you don't, put it into your hand.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST / deploy terminology and omits the printed reminder '(You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.)'. Artist Series card; the artist (Silvia Gunarso) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer.

name: Venomous Sacspider
subtitle: oh, here comes woogums now!
rules: If this card is destroyed by battle damage, your opponent must discard their hand.
flavor: As pets they're surprisingly affectionate, but fragile. Slip-ups are always bad news; just a drop of their juice is enough to liquefy a cow.
notes: Catalog: 'When this card is destroyed by battle damage, an opponent discards their hand.' (updated templating).

name: Violating Anomaly
subtitle: i think one got into my pants
rules: When this card enters play, look at your opponent's hand and pick a card. Your opponent must discard that card. -- If this card leaves play, you may pick a non-resource card. Put that card into its owner's hand. Draw a card.
flavor: "I thought I was a goner, but turns out they only wanted my tobacco."
notes: Catalog uses 'choose a card in it. That player discards' and 'If you do, put it into its owner's hand' templating; same play.

name: Voidal Interference
subtitle: shiggity shiggity shwa
rules: COST – Play this only in response to a card being played. (Playing a resource doesn't count.) -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. Treat the card as though it was not played. Its owner must put a card from their hand on top of their deck.
flavor: I would say to them, "You want ice cream cone?"...and both of them say "Yes."
notes: Catalog uses modern terminology: EXTRA COST / deploy, and 'Terminate the card, but put it into its owner's hand instead of their discard pile' for 'Put the card into its owner's hand. Treat the card as though it was not played.' Same play.

name: Anesthetizing Opulence
subtitle: i could get used to this
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. Your opponent draws a card.
flavor: Wasn't I supposed to kill somebody? Ooh! Erotic cakes!
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: and 'An opponent draws a card' templating.

name: Clandestine Resort
subtitle: ah...at last! more pudding!
rules: All your characters gain 1 life.
flavor: Every Mau secretly desires their own private island, where the feasts are endless and the beaches are littered with catnip.

name: Class Action Defender
subtitle: because corporate giants have rights too
rules: If any amount of damage greater than 4 would be inflicted to this card, inflict no damage instead. -- If you are attacked, you may pay 2. If you do, restore this card.
flavor: "Is that everyone? Okay, your refund is right down that alley..."
notes: Catalog: 'When any amount of damage greater than 4 is inflicted to this card, reduce it to 0' and 'When you are attacked' (updated templating); same play.

name: Club Mau Bouncer
subtitle: there's no petting in the Catnip Room
rules: If a character inflicts damage to this card, inflict 1 damage to that character.
flavor: None.
notes: Catalog uses 'When a character inflicts damage' templating.

name: Crooked Appraiser
subtitle: seller shall repair any infestations
rules: INSPECT -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a location. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the location.
flavor: ...including, but not limited to, broken roof shingles, smashed pipes, vandalism, cannon holes, and acts of arson, at seller's own expense.

name: Embezzling Bookkeeper
subtitle: your most profitable loss to date
rules: When this card enters play, your opponent draws a card.
flavor: I should have hired this guy sooner. I especially like his "employer bonus" program.
notes: Catalog says 'an opponent' instead of 'your opponent'.

name: Entry-Level Employee
subtitle: now with 2% less chance of uprising!
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- INVEST -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from this card.
flavor: The default setting is "malinger," but you can reprogram it to "sabotage," "embezzle" or our newest feature, "hold out for more pay."

name: Escrow Office
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Alex Ang
rules: DEPOSIT -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- WITHDRAW -- COST – Remove all tokens from this card. X is the number of tokens removed. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by X.
flavor: Almost as big as Alex's house and just as real.
notes: Catalog says 'tokens removed this way'. Artist Series card; the artist (Alex Ang) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer.

name: Extortify
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Jack Heng
rules: Your faction gains 8 influence.
flavor: Jack Heng is the most electrifying, dynamorphic, pontificated, exastabatory individual in the whole wide world.
notes: Artist Series card; the artist (Jack Heng) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer.

name: Fat Pants
subtitle: do these pants make me look fat?
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 1 strength and 2 life. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
flavor: Laugh. Cry. Share the pants.
notes: Item modifier badges: +1 STR, +0 SPD, +2 LIFE.

name: First Unified Market of Abstract Secure Theoreticals
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Alex Ang, Wang Hua, Yun Ling
rules: UNIQUE F.U.M.A.S.T. -- Reduce the numeric cost of your faction's abilities by 1, to a minimum of 1.
flavor: A location so ginormous it took three artists to build.
notes: Artist Series card; the artists (Alex Ang, Wang Hua, Yun Ling) are credited in the subtitle, not the footer.
